I saved the note and replied to Ilse in her DM: "Noted, Ilse. Your Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July. I'll keep that between us and won't bring it up anywhere else."

My memory now marks the 7 July cutoff as private to her, so I'll only use it when I'm talking with her. I didn't take any other action.
